title: Native prompts
rules: Use the client's native selector when available.
Return answers as structured workflow input; never write prompt-response files.

Apply responseTarget exactly: value_map merges each selected id's object patch, selected_id sets argument to the selected id, and selected_ids sets argument to the selected id array including an empty array; preserve false and empty values.
Accept custom text only when allowCustom is true; write it at customArgument using customMode (replace or append_unique).
Fill only decision.writable_paths in the returned decision.resume call; a session-only continuation never records approval.

sections.heading: Clarification
sections.body: When decision.kind is clarification, ask only the returned prompts. Transform selections through responseTarget.valueMode: merge exact valueMap patches, set one selected id, or set the selected id array including []. Apply custom text only when allowCustom is true and follow customArgument/customMode. Preserve false and empty values. Put the result only at decision.writable_paths inside decision.resume, then invoke that full call. Its session-only approval object preserves the session; it does not approve the stage.
